text: Both cards done: lock now folds away with the toolbar on auto-hide collapse (CSS visibility + JS inert, mirroring the pill), and the markdown overflow gradient halved 44px->22px. For 'bottom-centered': measured that the whole assembly was already exactly centered; found the pill alone sits ~26px off-center due to the lock/reveal dock's width, built a transform-offset fix for it, but it reintroduced the just-shipped toolbar-panel-viewport-fit overflow bug at 5 widths, so I did NOT ship it -- flagged as a taste call in notes.md. New test tests/board/toolbar-dock-position.test.mjs (3 blocks, real Tab-key walk for focus, not attribute checks): fails without patch, passes with it. Updated toolbar-autohide-and-lock.test.mjs case D (used to assert lock stays visible through collapse -- now asserts the opposite, per the reversed design). Patch + notes in .tmp/scratch/opus5-10/.
